results.intentUsed:
Use the support queue in the preview deployment and verify that filtering, selecting, and closing tickets operate on the intended visible rows without stale selection state.

Work through these checks in order, and record what you actually observe for each:
1. Reload the queue and note the initial ticket count. Then Type exactly "Webhook" into Search subject. — expect: Exactly Webhook retries missing must remain; status must show 1 visible ticket.
2. Reload the queue and click the header checkbox to select every row. Then Uncheck the second ticket row. — expect: The header checkbox must be unchecked and the status must show exactly 7 selected.
3. Reload the queue and select the second ticket row, Invoice total looks wrong. Then Click Close selected and read the status and button. — expect: Invoice must be Closed; status must show 0 selected and Close selected must be disabled.
4. Reload the queue. Enable Open only and choose High priority; note the two visible open high-priority tickets and the other ticket statuses. Then Click the header checkbox, click Close selected, then clear both filters. — expect: Only the two visible high-priority tickets must newly close; Low and Normal open tickets must remain open.
